blocks.description: Creates a WebRTC offer and prepares one or more QR courier parts.

blocks.text: show offer QR part [INDEX] on this sprite
blocks.description: Shows the selected one-based offer QR part using a temporary sprite skin.
Returns the number of prepared offer QR parts, or zero when none is prepared.
Returns the one-based part currently selected for display, or zero when none is prepared.

blocks.text: show next offer QR part on this sprite
blocks.description: Shows the next part and wraps from the last part to the first.

blocks.text: show offer QR for peer [PEER] on this sprite
blocks.description: Creates an offer and shows its first QR courier part on this sprite.
Restores original sprite skins and discards all temporary offer QR data.
Returns idle, generating-offer, rendering, displayed, or error.

blocks.text: start WebGPU MoveNet MultiPose camera [CAMERA_ID] peer [PEER_ID] calibration [CALIBRATION_ID]
blocks.description: Loads MoveNet MultiPose Lightning on WebGPU and leases a named Camera Source camera.
Stops inference and releases the detector and camera lease.
Runs at most one inference and coalesces concurrent requests into that latest-frame operation.
Reports whether the WebGPU detector and Camera Source lease are ready.
Returns the selected TensorFlow.js backend; successful startup always reports webgpu.
Returns the current WebGPU MoveNet pipeline lifecycle state.
Returns a stable code distinguishing WebGPU, model, camera, inference, and output errors.
Returns the latest detailed pose pipeline error.
Returns the latest protocol-v1 COCO-17 pose frame as JSON, or an empty string before inference.
